symptoms: ONLYOFFICE rendered tables as Left-to-Right despite passing RTL tests
Root Chapter_4_Results.docx was stale and had defective bidiVisual w:val='1'
root_cause: The compile script was only compiling to 03_deliverables/ and only copying the .md file to the root directory. This left the root Chapter_4_Results.docx stale from an earlier run. The stale file contained a defective <w:bidiVisual w:val="1"/> element, which ONLYOFFICE discarded, defaulting to Left-to-Right rendering.
resolution: Synchronized 03_deliverables/Chapter_4_Results.docx to the root directory. Verified that the updated DOCX contained clean, pure, empty <w:bidiVisual/> elements on all 25 tables, resolving the GUI rendering desync in ONLYOFFICE.
